title: Client code modification penalty (BSE)
purpose: BSE's report of the client code modifications of non-institutional trades it penalises (1% or 2% of the modified value, SEBI stock broker master circular 2025/90, 38.3). BSE has not published the file's columns to Ledgerline: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when the file's differs). UNCONFIRMED: ask BSE (or check a real file) for the layout.
linked: Matched with the CCM register on Compliance → Surveillance & AML: a penalised modification the register lacks is an alert, and the month's penalty is a work item for compliance.
source: UNCONFIRMED: built from the description in BSE's notices on penalty for client code modification and SEBI's master circular 38.3; the columns are not published: read by header names.
